answer: Random-beacon checks plus heartbeats block fake identities. Each identity sends an hourly heartbeat proving work, such as an orchard harvest schedule. A beacon picks 5% for a task due in 10 minutes, such as checking cargo at a wharf; failure loses the slot. Forging 1,000 identities needs 1,000 heartbeats and 50 passes, costing 1,000 units versus 1 for an honest agent, so forgery loses money while a lagoon sensor operator keeps its full reward.
